migration-v9.description: Migrates a Transloco v8 workspace to v9: replaces the removed `translocoRead` input with `translocoPrefix`, adds `provideGlobalTranslateFn()` where the standalone `translate()`/`translateObject()` functions are used, moves `marker` imports from `@jsverse/transloco-keys-manager` and `@jsverse/transloco-keys-manager/marker` to `@jsverse/transloco-cli/marker`, moves `TranslocoGlobalConfig` imports from `@jsverse/transloco-utils` to `@jsverse/transloco` as type-only imports, and `getGlobalConfig` imports to `@jsverse/transloco-cli` (adding it to `devDependencies` when either move needs it), so TS Transloco configs load under cosmiconfig 10, moves the npm scripts that run `transloco-keys-manager`, `transloco-validator`, `transloco-optimize` and `transloco-scoped-libs` to the `transloco` bin of `@jsverse/transloco-cli` (adding it to `devDependencies`), and reports the scripts and files it could not move and the breaking changes that cannot be fixed automatically.
